heroBody: Trading, risk, onboarding and back-office systems for Bangladesh’s brokerage houses, built by a consortium of the brokers themselves.
platformTitle: One platform for every step of a trade.
platformBody: From account opening to settlement, Xpert connects the systems a brokerage house runs every day.
capTradingBody: Order entry and order management for DSE and CSE, on web and mobile.
capRiskBody: Limits and exposure checks on every order before it reaches the exchange.
capEkycBody: Verify investors digitally and take paperwork out of onboarding.
capBoBody: Open beneficiary-owner accounts online, from application to approval.
capDmsBody: Keep client documents organised, linked to the account and easy to find.
capBackBody: Accounts, settlement and reporting for the brokerage back office.
capDataBody: Licensed market data and analysis for investors and dealers.

flowStep4: The order goes to DSE or CSE

consortiumBody: Xpert Fintech Ltd. is a consortium of leading brokerage houses that pooled their experience to build shared, modern market technology.
p1Body: Every order passes pre-trade risk checks before it is sent to the exchange.
p2Body: Designed around DSE and CSE workflows, BO accounts and local brokerage operations.
p3Body: Orders and account activity are recorded, so teams can see what happened and when.
p4Body: Investors and dealers work from the browser or the mobile app.

platformPageBody: Trading, risk, onboarding and back-office systems, designed to work as one for Bangladesh’s brokerage houses.
consortiumPageBody: Xpert Fintech Ltd. is a consortium of leading brokerage houses in Bangladesh, dedicated to advancing the country’s financial technology landscape.
footerCtaBody: Talk to the team that builds Bangladesh’s brokerage technology.
ecoAria: Diagram of Bangladesh’s capital market: investors trade through a brokerage house running Xpert, which connects to banks, the Dhaka and Chittagong stock exchanges and the central depository CDBL, all regulated by BSEC.
ecoText1: Investors open BO accounts online with eKYC. As a depository participant, the brokerage house registers each account with CDBL.
ecoText2: Orders from web and mobile pass the broker’s risk checks (RMS), then the OMS routes them to DSE or CSE for matching.
ecoText3: After a trade, the exchanges clear and settle it: shares move between BO accounts at CDBL, and money moves through the settlement banks.
ecoText4: BSEC regulates the whole market: the stock exchanges, the central depository and every brokerage house.
ecosystemTitle: Where Xpert sits in Bangladesh’s capital market.
ecosystemBody: A brokerage house connects investors, banks, the stock exchanges and the central depository, under the regulator’s oversight. Xpert runs the systems in the middle.
marketBody: Indices, top movers and Xpert’s share of the day’s turnover.
